extracted.intended_audience: authors and teams preparing systematic reviews and related evidence syntheses, guideline developers, and journal editors
extracted.subtask_description: Selecting and applying the appropriate PRISMA extension (or closely aligned reporting guideline) to ensure complete, transparent reporting of a systematic review or evidence synthesis according to the review question, data sources, or methods used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a PRISMA extension when review addresses a particular question or data source
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extensions provide reporting guidance for reviews that address particular review questions (e.g. diagnostic test accuracy) or use particular data sources (e.g. individual participant data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and apply the PRISMA extension that matches the review's question, population, intervention/exposure, outcome, synthesis method, or data type to ensure appropriate and complete reporting. See the specific extension pages for details and checklists.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Abstracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for abstracts of systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-Abstracts to structure and report key elements in the abstract so readers can quickly understand objectives, methods, results, and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Acupuncture
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for systematic reviews addressing acupuncture interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this extension when the review concerns acupuncture to ensure acupuncture-specific items (e.g., details of needling, practitioner background) are reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Children and Adolescents
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for reviews focused on child and adolescent populations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the population of interest is children/adolescents to ensure age-specific considerations and reporting are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Chinese Herbal Medicines
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for systematic reviews of Chinese herbal medicine interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to reviews of Chinese herbal medicines to capture intervention-specific details and relevant methodological concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Complex Interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for reviews of complex interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for interventions with multiple interacting components or complex implementation contexts to ensure complexity-related details are reported (e.g., components, fidelity, context).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-COSMIN for Outcome Measurement Instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension aligned with COSMIN providing guidance on reporting reviews of outcome measurement instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply when the review evaluates measurement properties of instruments (reliability, validity, responsiveness) to ensure instrument-specific reporting standards are met.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Diagnostic Test Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for diagnostic test accuracy systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for reviews of diagnostic accuracy to ensure reporting of participants, index test, reference standard, flow/timing, and accuracy estimates in a standardized way.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-EcoEvo
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for ecological and evolutionary systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to reviews in ecology/evolutionary biology to capture discipline-specific reporting needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for reviews addressing equity-related questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for reviews that assess health equity or disparities to ensure relevant population, context, and subgroup reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Harms
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing guidance on reporting harms (adverse events) in systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to ensure comprehensive and consistent reporting of adverse outcomes, their measurement, and synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Individual Participant Data
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for systematic reviews that use individual participant data (IPD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when IPD are collected/analysed to ensure reporting of IPD-specific methods (data collection, harmonization, missing data handling) and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Living Systematic Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for living systematic reviews that are continually updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to living reviews to capture processes for ongoing searching, updating, and versioning of results.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Moxibustion
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing reporting guidance for systematic reviews of moxibustion interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when reviewing moxibustion to ensure intervention-specific elements are described.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Network Meta-Analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting network meta-analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply for network meta-analyses to ensure reporting of network geometry, consistency assumptions, ranking, and methods specific to multi-arm evidence synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension providing guidance on reporting systematic review protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when preparing or publishing a protocol to ensure planned methods, eligibility, and analysis plans are clearly reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Scoping Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting scoping reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to scoping reviews to ensure appropriate reporting of objectives, inclusion criteria, search strategies, charting methods, and synthesis approaches suited to scoping aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension focused on reporting search methods in systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to ensure comprehensive reporting of search sources, strategies, dates, and any limits or deduplication procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: SWiM (Synthesis Without Meta-analysis)
rubrics_metrics.description: A reporting guidance closely aligned with PRISMA for systematic reviews of interventions that use alternative synthesis methods instead of meta-analysis of effect estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a review synthesizes results without quantitative meta-analysis (e.g., narrative, vote-counting, tabulation), follow SWiM to report synthesis methods, grouping of studies, and how certainty and heterogeneity were addressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: TIDieR-SRs (intervention reporting in systematic reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for reporting intervention details within systematic reviews (aligned with PRISMA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use TIDieR-SRs to ensure complete reporting of intervention components, delivery, dosage, and fidelity in included studies and syntheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — rapid reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: A PRISMA extension is being developed for rapid reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When conducting or reporting rapid reviews, look for and apply the forthcoming extension to capture methods and trade-offs inherent in rapid evidence synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — preclinical in vivo animal experiments
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension is under development for systematic reviews of preclinical in vivo animal experiments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this extension when available to ensure reporting tailored to preclinical study design and translational considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — systematic reviews of AI interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension under development for reviews of artificial intelligence (AI) interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once available, use this extension for AI intervention reviews to address AI-specific reporting (e.g., algorithm details, training/validation, deployment context).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — qualitative evidence syntheses
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension under development for qualitative evidence syntheses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this extension when available to ensure qualitative methods, analytic approach, and synthesis-specific reporting are covered.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — systematic reviews using GRADE
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension is being developed for systematic reviews that use GRADE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this extension to align reporting of certainty/quality assessments with GRADE-related processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — systematic reviews of prevalence
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension is being developed for prevalence systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to prevalence-focused reviews to capture specific methods for estimating and reporting prevalence and its uncertainty.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions under development — health economic evaluations
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension under development for systematic reviews of health economic evaluations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When available, use for reporting methods and results specific to economic evidence and synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA updates — network meta-analysis, scoping reviews, protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: Planned updates to PRISMA for network meta-analysis, scoping reviews, and systematic review protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult updated PRISMA guidance when published to ensure the most current reporting expectations are followed for these review types.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA partial update for AI tools in the review process
rubrics_metrics.description: A partial update of PRISMA 2020 is planned to incorporate guidance on the use of AI tools in the systematic review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using AI tools (e.g., for screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias automation), follow forthcoming guidance on how to report tool use, settings, and validation to ensure transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process for developing a new PRISMA extension
rubrics_metrics.description: If interested in developing a new PRISMA 2020 extension, applicants must complete an application form and email it to the PRISMA Executive; proposals will be considered against criteria for approving new PRISMA extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective developers should complete the official application form and read the (linked) criteria for approval; the PRISMA Executive evaluates proposals at monthly meetings. Follow the application instructions and ensure the proposed extension addresses a clear reporting need.
